div.head: I Cn 2.5
div.ab: ⁊ gif hit þonne to bote gegá, ⁊ sy cyningc þæt geþafige, þonne bete man þæt cyricgrið into þære cyricean be ciningces fullan mundbryce, ⁊ þa my[n]sterclænsunge begyte, swa þærto gebyrige, ⁊ ægþer ge mægbote ge manbote fullice gebete, ⁊ wið God huru þingie georne.

And gif hit þonne to bote gega, ⁊ se cyningc þæt geþafige, þonne bete man þæt cyricgriþ into þare cyrican be cyninges fullan mundbrece, ⁊ þas mynstres clansunge begyte, swa ðarto gebyrige, ⁊ ægðær ge mægbote ge manbote fullice gebete, ⁊ wyð Gode huru þingye georne.

Si tunc ad emendationem ueniat, et rex ita patiatur, emendet ęcclesię pacem in ipsam ęcclesiam plena regis mundbrice, et reconciliationem ęcclesię requirat (querat), sicut ad eam pertinebit, et mægbotam et manbotam plene emendet (reddat), et saltem erga (apud) Deum sedulo componat.

⁊ gif hit þonne to bote gegá ⁊ se cyningc þæt geþafige, þonne bete man þæt cyricgrið into þære cyricean be ciningces fullan mundbryce, ⁊ þa my[n]sterclænsunge begyte swa þærto gebyrige, ⁊ ægþer ge mægbote ge manbote fullice gebete, ⁊ wið God huru þingie georne.

And gif hit þonne to bote gega and se cyningc þæt geþafige, þonne bete man þæt cyricgrið into þære cyricean be ciningces fullan mundbryce, and þa mynsterclænsunge begyte, swa þærto gebyrige, and ægþer ge mægbote ge manbote fullice gebete, and wið God huru þingie georne.

Und wenn es nun zur Busszahlung kommt, indem der König dies erlaubt, dann büsse [jener] Mann den [Bruch des] Sonderfriedens der Kirche an jene [verletzte] Kirche durch vollen [Betrag der Busse für] Bruch des königlichen Sonderschutzes und beschaffe die Kirchenreinigung, wie dazu gehört, und zahle Busse für den [Erschlagenen], sowohl als Verwandten [an die Sippe] wie als Untergebenen [an dessen Herrn], vollständig und sühne vor allem eifrig gegenüber Gott.

And if it then comes to compensation, the king permitting it, let [that] man pay compensation for [breach of] the church's protection to that [violated] church at the full [amount for] breach of the king's protection, and obtain the cleansing of the minster as is fitting, and pay compensation for the [slain man] in full, both as kinsman [to the kindred] and as dependant [to his lord], and above all make eager atonement to God.

And if it comes to the payment of compensation, and the king allows this course, amends for the violation of the protection of the church shall be made by the payment to the church in question of the full fine for breach of the king's mund, and the purification of the church shall be carried out as is fitting, and compensation both to the kin and to the lord of the slain man shall be fully paid, and above all supplication shall earnestly be made to God.

And if it then reaches the point at which compensation may be paid and the king allows it, payment of an amount equal to the full penalty for violating the king’s protection shall be given to the particular church as penance for the violation of the church’s sanctuary, and the cleansing of the church shall take place in the proper manner, and compensation to both the family and lord of the victim shall be fully paid, and most importantly, prayers are to be faithfully offered up to God.
div.note: In G, ‘gif’ was written above the line in another hand. Liebermann compares VIII Atr 3.
